scope: One previously inspected ep34 sample0 resblock0 conv1 complete operator; not a new workload and not RTL/PPA evidence
order: native T/y/x; for each M tile, all8 N slices are completed independently; every output tile retains its Y across all432 K partitions. No T/P permutation and no split-K independent layer sums.
apec: Adjacent input positions in each same-T/same-y horizontal G2 or G4 group. Compute full-C intersection O; remove O from each input position; freshly im2col the residual and rebuild its per-K parent forest. Common theta*W tap vectors scatter to every valid original destination. Parent cache holds residual only.
finite_output_policy: Process common scatter for each M/N output tile before its full-K residual accumulation. Recompute a common G/tap value when its consumers cross M-tile boundaries; charge all repeated coefficient reads and construction. No free full-frame output SRAM.

resources.weight_cache_policy: LRU16 shared between common and residual service; invalidate at each output M/N tile; current K required coefficients are prefetched, all actual misses charged
resources.weight_cache_ports: one read plus one refill write, both1cycle
resources.source_bitmap_bank_rule: linear128bit word address modulo8; one read and one write per bank; this is a declared new source-memory model, not a mapped macro claim
resources.common_bitmap_ports: one128bit read plus one128bit write per cycle
resources.matcher: 64 rows plus3 pipeline cycles per K tile; maximum legal actual-parent subset, stable index tie; no arbitrary virtual intersections in the Prosperity baseline
resources.dispatch: one nonempty row or common G/tap record per cycle
resources.boundary_padding: physical64-row descriptor load and matcher even for final56-row tile; dummy rows never commit
resources.output_backing_bus: same768bit bus;6 beats per nonzero output vector, one beat per explicit zero-output marker; all3000*8 output-vector identities commit
resources.value_sram_port_ownership: parent and output are two separate memories; each independently uses the stated1R1W or1RW ports
resources.bitmap_logic: one128bit AND or XOR per cycle, latency1; g-1 ANDs and g XORs per group word, all charged
resources.apec_input_group_temporary_bits: at most4*768 input bits plus768 common bits, separate from four wide-value operand/pending registers
resources.weight_prefetch_ownership: Only current K after obtaining backend execution ownership; no next-K fill while common/current-K uses LRU16
resources.zero_marker_authority: Only original full-K support being empty proves a zero output vector. Never residual emptiness or sampled diagnostic-lane zeros.
resources.source_bitmap_physical_order: q-major then channel-word, q=T/y/x linear; explicitly packed from the captured tensor with full incoming bitmap transfer charged
resources.bitmap_read_dedup_scope: unique128bit source words only within one emitted16-feature row descriptor; no cross-row/M/K/N read cache
resources.initialization: one valid-map clear cycle per M/N output tile and per K parent epoch; data vectors lazily initialized on first real assignment; all writes drain before buffer/epoch reuse
resources.common_value_lifetime: One G/tap value at a time in the source accumulator, retained until every selected consumer has consumed it

overlap: Two descriptor buffers bound loading/matching ahead of execution: tile k loading cannot start before execution k-2 releases a buffer. Frontend can prepare while common branch executes. Source reduction and destination RMW have separate explicitly counted96-lane ALUs, with one source accumulator, one coefficient/parent transfer operand, one destination-read operand and one pending-write value (four vectors total), plus value-memory scoreboards. Finish and drain each complete M/N tile before the next.
input_cost: Charge full raw source bitmap input transfer, APEC input-bank reads/AND/XOR/in-place residual writes/common writes, and on-demand im2col unique128bit source word reads with actual bank conflicts. Both baselines regenerate their descriptors under the same source service model.
numerical_contract: Exact frozen scalar theta from sealed identity, represented as a power-of-two rational. Use deterministic signedINT8 diagnostic W and48bit numerator sums with proven no overflow. Verify complete support decomposition and parent equations plus selected diagnostic output lanes across all3000 outputs. This does not evaluate actual trained FP32 weights or new AEE.
measures: phase cycles and active resource service counts
original vs residual parent hits/inherited source counts
common reconstruction repeated across M tiles
analysis_boundary: This is a new explicit finite-resource CPU model, not the previous unmodified official model or physical timing of m935. Native order, coefficient width and resource allocation differ from the previous official reference; those old cycles are not denominators. No frequency, power, area or admission claim.
stop_and_changes: Run every declared mode/port point once after functional checks. Preserve negative results. Fix blocking implementation errors with recorded failed attempts and versioned reruns, never rewrite a measured result or select a better group/port after hiding the others.
missing_artifact: User-referenced24 copy-diff and CardJ93d8529 are not present in this shared workspace search. Original ExSpike and Prosperity plus sealed captures are the provisional, explicitly named sources; no tau-reuse gate is assumed.
pre_measurement_addendum: Independent review clarified port ownership, prefetch exclusion, original-support zero markers and bitmap throughput before any target outcome was run.
